ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels; high-intensity (white) pixels are sparse, comprising less than 10% of the surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark base across both lobes; high-contrast white pixels are localized in thin, scattered linear streaks and dense circular clusters at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct U-shaped central depression; interior walls converge at an approximate 45-degree angle with a rounded base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency jagged variations along the boundary; high pixel-amplitude serrations observed specifically on the distal sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory for the leading edge; trailing edge exhibits a complex, irregular jagged trajectory with overall convex curvature of the lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible clusters of circular, high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated heavily on the distal tips and scattered along the trailing edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous multi-directional, high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (scratches and rake marks) distributed across the ventral surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified barnacle colonies at the lobe tips and significant rake marks/scarring across the ventral plane.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced, irregular protrusion on the right tip (image-right) caused by dense, three-dimensional barnacle accumulation extending beyond the geometric edge of the fluke.
